question:
A Senior Software Engineer (7 years of experience) reported a roughly **30-minute LLD round at Walmart** on a **Naukri-style job portal**, with the focus on the **Person and Job `@ManyToMany` relationship**.

The same round also included various questions on Java, Kubernetes, Docker and Spring Boot. The reported takeaway was that you should know Java and Spring Boot thoroughly. The post does not give more detail on the exact schema or API expected, so be ready to model entities, the many-to-many link (applications) and the JPA mapping, and to defend it.
lookingFor: Can you model a many-to-many relationship correctly, including when it needs its own entity?
Do you know how JPA/Hibernate maps `@ManyToMany`, owning side, join table and fetch types?
Can you spot pitfalls like N+1 queries, cascade misuse and bidirectional mapping bugs?
Do you have working knowledge of Spring Boot, Docker and Kubernetes basics?
Can you keep the design simple and time-boxed for a 30-minute round?
followUps: Why would you replace @ManyToMany with an Application entity?
What is the N+1 problem and how do you fix it in JPA?
What is the difference between a Docker container and a Kubernetes pod?
How would you prevent a person from applying twice to the same job under concurrency?
